summary: Complete product listing page template integrating shop header, breadcrumbs, category header, filter bar, product grid, and load more.

Integration with filter bar and Google Retail Connect filter suggestions

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Product Listing Page template assembles all category browsing components into a cohesive shopping experience. It enables shoppers to browse and compare products within categories through an organized listing page with navigation, filtering, and infinite scroll capabilities.

## Use Cases

- Display products in a responsive grid layout with lazy loading
- Show breadcrumb navigation reflecting the full category path
- Display category header with title, SEO text, and subcategory navigation
- Implement load more functionality with progress indication
- Handle empty state with helpful messaging and alternative content
- Integrate filter bar with Google Retail Connect filter suggestions
- Provide content slots for newsletter blocks and promotional materials

## Design Rationale

The page template follows a composable architecture, assembling independent components (ShopHeader, Breadcrumbs, CategoryHeader, Filterbar, ProductGrid, LoadMore, Footer) into a complete page experience. This enables consistent page structure across categories while allowing individual components to be updated or swapped independently. The integration points between components (filter state affecting grid, load more triggering grid updates) are handled through shared state management.
shortDescription: Follows composable architecture assembling independent components (ShopHeader, Breadcrumbs, CategoryHeader, Filterbar, ProductGrid, LoadMore, Footer) into a complete page. Integration points between components use shared state management for filter state affecting grid and load more triggering updates. Handles empty state with helpful messaging. MVP includes standard filter bar with Google Retail Connect filter suggestions for collection pages.
